{"notes": "VISIT 1 (1:00). Table settled on a fish. Only one chain is visible, running from the start toward the upper right, all connected, with Leo's hands at its tip. Roughly a dozen dominoes in, with no gaps. I can't confirm who placed what, so these are provisional.

LEO: Hands at the tip of the connected chain, so he is visibly laying the body from the nose, which is the critical path. Quickly accepted Priya's sketch over his own ('Priya's sketch works'), which is good collaboration. Noted that the tail waits for the body, so he sees the dependency. Watch: he claimed both top and bottom of the body and told Tom he didn't need to wait. That could be efficient or could make him a bottleneck and sideline Tom. Early plan was also inconsistent with Priya's (he had Maya on the top fin, Priya on the eye).

PRIYA: Had the sketch drawn already, put it in the middle so everyone could use it, and gave clear stroke assignments, including closing the tail and inspecting for gaps. Strong organizing and leadership, and she credited Leo publicly. Her private update was useful but is self-report. She's not visibly placing yet, so I need to see her execution.

MAYA: Assigned the tail edges. Silent this visit and no visible hands. No evidence either way. Check next visit.

TOM: Assigned the bottom body, then told by Leo to take a tail stroke instead. Silent, no visible hands. Check whether he's engaged or sidelined, and whether the role change was clear to him.

TO CHECK NEXT: tail joined to body, who is idle, whether Priya actually inspects, and any hand-off friction."}
